svg.text: A ride, end to end (games-only, the demo setting)
Who sends what, in order. Ride Mode on is the consent: no accept step. Mission mode (GAMES_ONLY=false) differs at step 7.
Rider's phone
+ glasses

/api

(this trip)

screen + Pi
GameRoom

Partner
(Rae)
tap the car-1412 tag → opens /k/1412, picks a stop, confirms
POST /api/taps { car, destination, rideMode: true } → checkIn
ride.state riding · ride.snapshot (phone + glasses sockets)
Rae checks in on car 1413 the same way
runMatching: pool → gate → score → greedy → meeting point
match.found { partner, why, meetAtCar 1413, carDelta +1, game }
pair.incoming → screen shows Sam & Rae · LEDs glow the pair color
match.found (she stays put: boarded last)
walk one car forward, tap the 1413 tag (= arrived)
pair.incoming arrived 2 of 2: "play on your phones or glasses"
open /m?code&seat (or the lens takes the seat)
polls view(seat b) every 700 ms
Tall tale → First impressions → Left for you (both vote to go on)
gamesDone(matchId)
stamp.awarded (both) → stamp screen + passport
celebrate → "Stamped!" → pair.cleared: kiosk is free
rest both riders 90 s, then they can be matched again
Mission mode instead: arriving starts a curated mission,
the Pi writes a fresh ?n= nonce to the tag (nfc.write),
both tap within the window → stamp. Missions end
30 s before the next stop; riders leave at their stop.
Glasses link before the ride; once a poll sees the rider
checked in they open a socket. A stamp missed while the
page was hidden comes back in ride.snapshot.recentStamp.
